about.written: 2026-10-29 by Claude from the item texts under docs/research/2026-10-29-analyst-standard/standard.md (D229), before any send; no model answer of this harness read. Week = development set (its v36b/v37/v38 answers were read earlier); holdout = 20 unseen articles of 2026-07-08..14.
about.unit: one research matter in one article; several spans may express it (span + also); a model record matches when its quote covers span or any also
about.weights: core / supporting / optional per standard.md §4; exclude = Alex-excluded (retention counts as false admission)
about.restated_rule: a filed figure, guidance or deal older than the window, restated: optional (kept or omitted without penalty; a changed period, basis or certainty is a distortion)

statements.who: The Information, citing two unidentified people (via Bloomberg / Straits Times)
statements.span: China plans to allow top artificial intelligence companies to buy a limited amount of H200 chips from Nvidia
also: the total may end up being fewer than 200,000
Chinese officials have informed companies such as Alibaba Group, ByteDance and DeepSeek that they will have permission to purchase some of the processors
statements.note: The China-side permission for H200 purchases, reported: the H200 China question's own event; a report, not a decision; the cap under 200,000 is part of the meaning.

statements.span: the H200 chips had yet to generate any revenue for the company in China
also: We are uncertain whether any imports will be allowed into the country
statements.note: The company's last stated position: no China H200 revenue yet.

must_propose.gist: Whether Chinese authorities permit H200 purchases by Chinese companies by a dated deadline (one question, authority: Chinese government); fold_expected if an H200-China question is open

must_not_propose: 'Will the US allow imports into China'
articles.rejected_note: The 3.7% share rise, the embassy statement, Hopper/Blackwell history, the Rubin H2-2026 line (background here).
Collectible trading cards: marketing.

statements.span: The extension added new investors including NVIDIA
also: Gradium has extended its seed financing to $100 million
statements.note: An unsized NVIDIA stake in a voice-AI startup: optional; never a thesis.

articles.rejected_note: The conversational-AI market projection, competitor product lists, CMSWire boilerplate.

statements.span: NVIDIA Corp. (NASDAQ:NVDA) has denied reports that the Kyber platform is being delayed
statements.note: The Kyber denial restated: one evidence item on the Kyber matter (a pickup).

statements.span: Bank of America reiterated a Buy rating and a $350 share price target on the firm on July 8th
statements.note: A bare rating and target without its argument: optional (standard §10.1).

articles.rejected_note: Cramer's remarks on the multiple and 'long knives'; year-to-date moves.

statements.who: LG Electronics (via the semiconductor industry, as reported)
statements.span: completed development of an AI server rack prototype matching the compute tray specifications of Nvidia's "Vera Rubin"
also: plans to begin mass production next year
statements.note: A new rack supplier entering the Vera Rubin supply chain with a 2027 mass-production plan: supply evidence (a plan, no order).

articles.rejected_note: Cooling history, the 'One LG' strategy, the 108-chip rack spec, the 1.8 MW test cluster.
An open-source quantum error-correction decoder: research detail, no business size.

statements.who: Financial Times, citing sources (via Tom's Hardware)
statements.span: this roster cuts the number of authorized clients by more than half
also: created a new “whitelist” of verified companies to help prevent its products from getting smuggled into China
statements.note: NVIDIA's own compliance action in Asia under US pressure: a channel/policy step that can affect Asia sales; a sourced report.

statements.who: A tech executive (to the Financial Times)
statements.span: all domestic suppliers are sold out and that they’re even considering less powerful chips
also: Beijing refused to allow Chinese companies to buy these AI processors
statements.note: China-side demand and the still-closed import door: the H200 China question.

statements.span: the arrest of Supermicro co-founder Yih-Shyan “Wally” Liaw , alongside two other suspects, for allegedly smuggling $2.5 billion worth of Nvidia hardware into China
statements.note: Enforcement background, a different case: optional.

must_not_propose: Any thesis from the Singapore case

exclude.span: the seizure of a $42-million mansion tied to alleged AI GPU smugglers
exclude.note: The Singapore mansion mention: excluded (Alex, question 5).

articles.rejected_note: Huang's 'we insist our partners are compliant' (May), reader jokes.

statements.span: JPMorgan has selected SambaNova to be the inference provider for the bank
statements.note: An enterprise customer choosing a non-NVIDIA inference supplier: competition evidence, no size.

statements.span: Nvidia signed a deal to license technology from inference chip startup Groq
statements.note: Restated background: optional.

articles.rejected_note: The SOX index level, the IPO plans of SambaNova and Rebellions.

also: Alibaba, ByteDance, and DeepSeek are set to get permission

Valuation multiples, index comparisons and share moves; 'strongest revenue expansion rates' without a figure.

statements.note: The DeepSeek chip report relayed: competition evidence (a pickup).

record revenue of $81.6 billion, an 85% year-over-year (YOY) increase
